narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Here is the recipe for large cluster rockets. May your products bring joy and luck to all those who gaze up them.
narrative.requestItemsText: Large cluster rockets require vast resources and skill to create, but their brilliance and beauty is worth that effort!  Bring me coins of ancestry and I will grant you the knowledge of their crafting.
